items.item_text: 01. All applicants are required to submit responses to the following supplemental questions. Your responses will provide information about your background and experience related to this position and will be used in the screening and selection process. Be concise yet specific and informative in your responses to these supplemental questions. "See resume," attachments or links will not be accepted as a substitute for your responses to the questions in the following boxes. Incomplete responses will not be considered. Please indicate below that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes | No

02. I understand that my application will be considered incomplete if any required sections of the application are not completed and/or if any documents that are required are not attached to my online application by the closing date. Options: Yes | No
03. Please specify your highest level of education. Options: High School or equivalent (GED) | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Juris Doctor | Doctorate Degree
04. Please indicate the field in which you have earned your degree in:
05. Please indicate the number of years of experience you have processing payroll. Options: No experience | One Year | Two Years | Three Years | Four Years | Five Years or more
06. Do you have work experience in Higher Education? Options: Yes | No
07. Indicate where you have worked to obtain experience in payroll. What was the time frame? What was the employer's name? Describe the work performed. This section is required.

08. Which best describes your experience performing payroll calculations, including wages, deductions, overtime, retroactive pay, and payroll adjustments? Options: A. I have limited experience performing payroll calculations and primarily follow established instructions. | B. I regularly perform routine payroll calculations, including wages and deductions. | C. I independently perform complex calculations, including overtime, retroactive pay, adjustments, and other compensation changes. | D. I have extensive experience performing, reviewing, and auditing complex payroll calculations and resolving calculation errors.

09. Which best describes your experience reviewing, auditing, and reconciling payroll information? Options: A. I have limited experience auditing or reconciling payroll information. | B. I review payroll information and reconcile routine discrepancies using established procedures. | C. I independently audit payroll transactions, investigate discrepancies, and reconcile payroll records. | D. I regularly perform complex payroll audits and reconciliations, identify trends or systemic errors, and recommend corrective actions.

10. Which best describes your knowledge and experience applying federal and state payroll tax requirements? Options: A. I have limited knowledge of payroll tax requirements. | B. I have applied routine payroll tax procedures with established guidelines or supervision. | C. I independently apply federal and state payroll tax requirements when processing payroll and resolving employee tax issues. | D. I have extensive experience interpreting and applying payroll tax requirements, identifying compliance issues, and ensuring accurate tax reporting and withholding.

11. Which best describes your experience interpreting and applying collective bargaining agreements to payroll or compensation matters? Options: A. I have no experience applying collective bargaining agreements to payroll. | B. I have limited experience using collective bargaining agreements with guidance from others. | C. I independently interpret and apply contract provisions related to compensation, overtime, leave, or other payroll matters. | D. I have extensive experience interpreting multiple collective bargaining agreements and resolving complex payroll issues involving contract provisions.

12. Which best describes your experience using payroll, HRIS, or financial systems? Options: A. I have limited experience using payroll or HRIS systems. | B. I regularly enter and retrieve employee and payroll information using a payroll or HRIS system. | C. I independently use payroll/HRIS systems to process, verify, audit, and report payroll information. | D. I have extensive experience using payroll/HRIS systems, including data validation, reporting, troubleshooting, system testing, or process improvements.

13. Describe how you have demonstrated sensitivity and understanding in delivery of services and support to a diverse workforce and student population (diverse in terms of socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic background). This section is required.
Associate degree, in Business, Accounting, Economics, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field.
Bachelor’s degree, or higher, in Business, Accounting, Economics, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field.
Two (2) years of experience processing payroll.
Three (3) years of experience processing payroll.

Demonstrated experience working with communities who have been traditionally underserved by higher education and experience in the pedagogy reflecting intersections of race, culture, class, ethnic, and queer communities.
Computes wages, deductions, and performs complex payroll calculations, including retroactive payroll adjustments and verification of overtime pay rates.
Reviews and audits employee time sheets, work charts, wage computations, and other information to detect and reconcile payroll discrepancies.
Compiles and maintains employee time, production, and payroll data from time sheets; maintains complex payroll spreadsheets and generates payroll-related reports.
Processes paperwork for new employees and enters and updates employee information including but not limited to exemptions, transfers, and resignations, in the payroll system.

Compiles statistical reports, statements, and summaries related to payroll, benefits, and accounts; assists in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial and technical reports and closing functions.
Trains employees on the District’s timekeeping system and payroll procedures; prepares and delivers presentations related to assigned areas as required.
Records adjustments to pay related to previous errors or retroactive increases.
Processes and issues employee paychecks and statements of earnings and deductions.
Verifies attendance, hours worked, pay adjustments, and payroll deductions; inputs and verifies payroll transactions and related data.
Keeps track of paid time off (PTO) for employees.
Provides information to employees and managers regarding payroll, tax issues, benefit plans, and collective bargaining agreement provisions; resolves payroll-related discrepancies and issues.
Completes verifications of employment.
Reviews departmental documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy; conducts audits of payroll transactions.
Files and maintains departmental documents, records, reports, and related materials. \
Performs related duties as assigned.
Comprehensive understanding of payroll principles, processing cycles, and best practices.
In-depth familiarity with state and federal wage and tax regulations, including FLSA and IRS requirements.
Expertise in financial record-keeping, auditing methods, and reconciliation of payroll data.
Strong understanding of district policies and procedures to ensure compliance in payroll operations.
Proficiency with Los Angeles County Office of Education (LACOE) payroll systems and electronic timekeeping software for accurate data management.
Competence with general office software for reporting, data aggregation, and communication.
Proficiency in utilizing payroll and HRIS software to input, extract, verify, and audit data.
Clear and effective oral and written communication for interacting with staff and documenting payroll activities.
Strong customer service focus, including conflict resolution and explaining complex payroll information.
Accuracy and timeliness in payroll processing under tight deadlines and changing priorities.
Capacity to establish and maintain collaborative relationships with staff, departments, and external stakeholders.
Learns and applies emerging technologies to improve efficiency, organization, and timeliness of payroll processes.
Ability to interpret and apply collective bargaining agreements to payroll and compensation.
Skill in applying payroll laws and agreements to resolve discrepancies and ensure accurate employee compensation.
Advanced ability to perform payroll and mathematical calculations quickly and accurately.
Organizational and prioritization skills for managing multiple payroll tasks simultaneously.
